content:
eve: Seeing a weird scaling loop in us-west-2 GPU pool — nodes keep coming up then immediately getting terminated. Apps hitting OOM or Pending.

sam: I see autoscaler logs showing repeated scale-up then drain events. Possibly spot preemptions + CA cooldown mismatch.

jin: Can you paste the kubectl output for pods in Pending + node creation events?

eve: Pasting quick snippets:
```
$ kubectl get pods -A | grep Pending | grep gpu
ml-training   train-run-9k2   0/1   Pending   0   2m
ml-training   train-run-9k3   0/1   Pending   0   1m

$ kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu -o wide
NAME                          STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION
gpu-node-spot-12              Ready    <none>   2m    v1.26
gpu-node-spot-13              NotReady  <none> 1m    v1.26
```

ops-bot: alert: cluster-autoscaler(us-west-2) restarted at 1782145692 (OOMOOM detector) :warning:

oncall-ml: @eve @sam I'm taking lead — will pause new GPU job admission and cordon suspicious nodes.

sam: Temporary mitigation: disable scale-to-zero in the GPU pool and raise min size to 2. Also increase CA scale-down-delay to 10m.

jin: I suspect a feedback loop: spot instances preempt -> pods rescheduled -> CA thinks we need more nodes -> new spot nodes created -> preempted again. Need either (a) switch to on-demand for critical queues or (b) tweak priority/eviction for training jobs.

eve: Applying quick fixes now:
```bash
# cordon current questionable nodes
kubectl cordon gpu-node-spot-13
# taint to prevent new pods
kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-spot-13 preempted=true:NoSchedule
# bump min size
gcloud container clusters update --node-pool=gpu --min-nodes=2 --region=us-west2 my-cluster
```

ops-bot: command executed: cordon and taint applied (1782145784).

oncall-ml: I'm also flipping the admission-controller flag for the ml namespace to reject new GPU requests until we stabilize.

sam: For post-incident: we should add CA filter for spot interruptions (use metadata signal) and add a policy to not autoscale based on Pending pods older than 3m for gpu pools.

jin: Agree. Also want a staged fallback: if spot preempt rate > 5% for 10m then route new jobs to dedicated pool (on-demand).

eve: Right now observed behaviour: 3 scale-ups in 8m, all 1-2 nodes each, then AWS reclaimed them. Costs spiked due to churn.

sam: @finance FYI — cost spike alert fired. We should capture exact token/credits impact later. :money_with_wings:

oncall-ml: Quick notes for the runbook: 1) cordon/taint preempted nodes 2) bump min-size 3) disable scale-to-zero 4) route critical queues to on-demand pool 5) adjust CA cooldowns.

eve: I'm collecting logs and will kick off a short postmortem. Will include timeline + config diffs.

jin: If someone can file the postmortem issue, tag infra and ml, and include recommended config changes. I'll draft CA policy PR.

oncall-ml: Filing now. Link: https://redwood-internal/ops/incidents/1782145678 (draft)

sam: Thanks all. Stand down but keep monitoring for 30m.

eve: Monitoring: no new scale-ups in last 5m, Pending queue shrinking. Closing incident channel in 30. :white_check_mark:
